Dodge and Parry is one of the Rogue Passives which is unlocked at level 10.

## Description

6 additional Dodge Rating and 3% increased Glancing Blow Chance per point.

### Mechanics[]

You have additional dodge rating and a chance to receive a Glancing Blow when hit.

Glancing Blows deal 35% less damage.
